format: per take: per tick part rot (xRot,yRot,zRot rad), offset_px from the vanilla pivot, pos [right, forward, up] blocks from the start, glow, cam_shake [pitch, yaw] degrees, event ('burst' = the second-jump puff). Body yaw = the run direction (deg clockwise from the look in 'run_deg'). 20 ticks a second.

rules.second_jump: a jump pressed while airborne from the first jump (any tick of it)
rules.standing_vs_running: horizontal speed under 0.15 blocks/tick at the second jump = standing puff; at or over = running arc along the horizontal velocity (only that way)
rules.standing: puff to 3.2 blocks above the jump-start ground, hero hover with a 0.07 bob (1.5 s), subtle shake 0.5 deg over 4 ticks; free flight on any movement input
rules.running: flat flight at 5 blocks 6 ticks after the second jump, speed 0.3 -> 0.95 blocks/tick through the arc, easing to 0.7 cruise; free flight after

name: running dart, arm a little forward
